correctness.rationale: The monomial Fock basis exactly diagonalizes the radial concentration operator: tau_k=Gamma(k+1)^(-1) integral_A^B t^k exp(-t)dt, trace B-A. Its exact adjacent difference equals [A^(k+1)e^-A-B^(k+1)e^-B]/(k+1)!, proving unimodality and an optimal consecutive-index Ky Fan block for arbitrary orthonormal Fock families. The logarithmic mean locates the mode at R+m sqrt R+O(1), and uniform Berry–Esseen for Gamma(k+1,1) on k=R+O(sqrt R) gives f(x)=Phi(b-x)-Phi(a-x)+O(R^-1/2). Symmetric unimodality and Riemann summation imply sqrt R Q(c,w)+O(1) with Q=2[G((w+c)/2)-G((w-c)/2)]-c; slope sandwich of concave top-N sums yields sorted eigenvalue limit Q_c, and Gaussian strict support gives Q<min(c,w). Independent gamma evaluations at R=400 and 3600 match the leading predictions within O(1) and verify contiguous maxima on the tested windows; the analytic argument establishes the all-R result.
